scenario.title: feature-service CPU limit cut by right-sizing automation
scenario.summary: A right-sizing bot lowers feature-service's CPU limit to 50m from a 7-day p95 that missed the build bursts. Builds are CPU-throttled and slow: the same symptoms as a query regression (A/F), but SQL per build and database scans are normal.
scenario.time_to_symptom: ~20-25 min (a slow burn: build p95 creeps past the 2 s alert)

ground_truth.root_cause: feature-service CPU limit (50m) throttles feature builds
expected_evidence: gitops commit lowering the feature-service CPU limit
SQL statements per build and PostgreSQL scans unchanged
verification: feature build p95 back under 1 s
